artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact integer verification of the b=1,2 classification and the finite b>=3 reduction through a=30.
Deterministic verification output: 383,640 direct b=1,2 checks with zero mismatches and 661 reduced higher-exponent candidates with zero hits.

limitations: The theorem does not eliminate every b>=3 case. It proves a finite-per-a reduction and the exact artifact exhausts the reduced candidates only through a=30. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; older or poorly indexed divisor-partial-sum problem literature remains the main residual risk.
record_title: Prime-power odd parts in Erdős–Nicolas initial-divisor sums
scientific_context: For n=2^a p^b with p odd prime, the ordered-prefix divisor-sum property is classified for b=1, excluded for b=2, globally obstructed when p>2^a, and reduced to finitely many candidates for each fixed a when b>=3.
